prompt: Name a city that has hosted the Summer Olympics

answers.name: London
answers.fact: Hosted in 1908, 1948 and 2012.

answers.name: Sydney
answers.fact: Cathy Freeman lit the cauldron and won the 400 m in 2000.

answers.name: Beijing
answers.fact: The first city to host both the Summer and Winter Games.

answers.name: Tokyo
answers.fact: Its 2020 Games were held in 2021, without spectators.

answers.name: Paris
answers.fact: Hosted exactly 100 years apart, in 1924 and 2024.

answers.name: Athens
answers.fact: Hosted the first modern Games, in 1896.

answers.name: Rio de Janeiro
answers.fact: The first South American host, in 2016.

answers.name: St Louis
answers.fact: Its 1904 marathon 'winner' was caught having ridden in a car.

answers.name: Los Angeles
answers.fact: Will host for a third time in 2028.

answers.name: Barcelona
answers.fact: The 1992 Games transformed its waterfront.

answers.name: Atlanta
answers.fact: Hosted the centennial Games in 1996.

answers.name: Seoul
answers.fact: Ben Johnson's 100 m disqualification made headlines in 1988.

answers.name: Moscow
answers.fact: Boycotted by the US and many other countries in 1980.

answers.name: Montreal
answers.fact: Took about 30 years to pay off its 1976 Olympic debts.

answers.name: Munich
answers.fact: Its Olympic Park has a famous tent-like roof.

answers.name: Mexico City
answers.fact: The altitude helped Bob Beamon's huge long jump in 1968.

answers.name: Rome
answers.fact: Abebe Bikila won the 1960 marathon barefoot.

answers.name: Berlin
answers.fact: Jesse Owens won four golds there in 1936.

answers.name: Melbourne
answers.fact: Its 1956 horse events were held in Stockholm because of quarantine rules.

answers.name: Amsterdam
answers.fact: The Olympic flame was first lit there, in 1928.

answers.name: Helsinki
answers.fact: Emil Zátopek won three long-distance golds there in 1952.

answers.name: Stockholm
answers.fact: Its 1912 stadium is still in use.

answers.name: Antwerp
answers.fact: The Olympic rings flag first flew there in 1920.
